svg.title: Women's Class A service dress coat, wearer's left sleeve laid flat (outer arm toward the viewer, plain Class A cuff, no braid), for NCO chevrons
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-a-coat-female-sleeve-flat-left","name":"Women's Class A service dress coat, wearer's left sleeve laid flat (outer arm toward the viewer, plain Class A cuff, no braid), for NCO chevrons","size_in":{"w":7.4616,"h":27.347},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,746.16,2734.7],"size_source":"measured","size_basis":"Measured on the sheet's own sleeve (garment-blues-class-a-coat-female; outline jacket_female.webp (612x753 px) traced at 0.047 in/px, scaled x0.88 (COAT_K)), straightened, then widened from the hanging view to the flat. Length 27.11 in = the outer edge's arc length from the shoulder seam point (the top of the armhole seam) down the drawn outline to the cuff's outer corner (the sheet's vertical drop is 26.22 in). Widths: a hanging sleeve seen from the front shows its diameter (circumference / pi); laid flat it measures circumference / 2, so each flat width = the hanging width measured on the sheet (square to the sleeve axis) x pi/2 = 1.5708. Hanging widths: full cap 4.63 in (the widest up to the elbow; the hanging sleeve is hidden under the shoulder, so its drawn width at the seam itself is 0), elbow 4.24 in (55 percent of the length, 14.91 in down), cuff edge 2.66 in (corner to corner as drawn, 10.98, 28.66 to 8.33, 28.44 in the sheet's frame). Flat widths: cap 7.28 in, elbow 6.67 in, cuff 4.17 in. Cross-check: the same factor as the men's flat; the women's 40R-equivalent circumference is not cited in the regulation. Box 7.46 x 27.35 in = sleeve plus 0.12 in on every
